notes.title: 🍰 COME BAKE WITH DREAM TEAM! Watch us play our game and bake some deserts!
notes.content:
Please join us for a special live Stream for the Steam Next Fest where the developers will be playing through Dreamland Confectionery and talking about their experience on the project!

Get a small taste of our journey and then [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1836480/Dreamland_Confectionery_Demo]download the demo for yourself[/url]!
